newsitem.title: USA: Chase Manhattan Corp Q3 shr rises.
newsitem.headline: Chase Manhattan Corp Q3 shr rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE - 1996 Q3 results for diluted share excluded merger- and restructuring-related expenses of $1.06 billion.
1996 Q3 fees related to credit cards were $277 million, up 32 percent from $210 million for 1995 Q3.
Assets at September 30, 1996, were $323 billion versus $308 billion as of September 30, 1995.
Deposits as of September 30, 1996, were $165 billion versus $166 billion as of September 30, 1995.
Loans as of September 30, 1996, were $150 billion versus $151 billion as of September 30, 1995.
Q3 primary share $1.85, diluted $1.83 excluding merger expenses.
First Call mean estimate for 1996 Q3 was $1.82 per share
